record.paper_title: Constructive Field Theory and Applications: Perspectives and Open Problems
record.original_question: Extend the constructive results on the Gutzwiller trace formula to longer time evolution.

evidence.quote: Here let us mention the results [CRR] on the Gutzwiller trace formula, that one would like to extend to longer time evolution.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M,g)$ be a smooth compact Riemannian manifold (or, more generally, let $H(x,\hbar D)$ be a self-adjoint semiclassical pseudodifferential operator on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with symbol $H(x,\xi)$ such that the energy surface $\Sigma_E=\{H=E\}$ is compact and regular). Let $H_\hbar$ denote the corresponding quantum Hamiltonian (e.g. $-\hbar^2\Delta/2$ or the Weyl quantization of $H$), and let $\varphi_t$ denote the Hamiltonian flow generated by $H$ on $T^*M$.

For a test function $\rho\in\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R})$ whose Fourier transform $\widehat{\rho}$ has compact support, and for $\chi\in C_c^\infty(\mathbb{R})$ localizing near energy $E$, the Gutzwiller trace formula gives, as $\hbar\to 0^+$, an asymptotic expansion of
$$\mathrm{Tr}\,\Big[\rho\!\left(\tfrac{E-H_\hbar}{\hbar}\right)\chi(H_\hbar)\Big]$$
as a sum of a Weyl-type term and oscillatory contributions indexed by the periodic orbits $\gamma$ of $\varphi_t$ on $\Sigma_E$ whose periods lie in $\mathrm{supp}\,\widehat{\rho}$, with amplitudes determined by the linearized Poincaré map and Maslov indices of $\gamma$.

Constructive (rigorous, with effective control on remainders) proofs of this formula are known under the restriction that $\widehat{\rho}$ is supported in a fixed time interval $[-T,T]$ with $T$ independent of $\hbar$ (the "short time" regime, or up to the Ehrenfest time $T\sim c\,|\log\hbar|$ in some settings).

Problem: Extend the Gutzwiller trace formula constructively to longer time evolution. That is, establish a version of the formula in which $T=T(\hbar)$ is allowed to grow as $\hbar\to 0$ beyond the Ehrenfest barrier $c\,|\log\hbar|$, with explicit, controlled remainder estimates, and identify the largest range of $T(\hbar)$ for which the periodic-orbit expansion remains asymptotically valid.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work has refined and extended Gutzwiller-type trace formulas (e.g., Maslov-type index refinements, continuous-time toroidal-phase-space versions, and complex-periodic-orbit formulations), but constructive control beyond the Ehrenfest time remains a recognized open challenge in semiclassical analysis. No verified proof of a Gutzwiller trace formula valid for time scales substantially longer than $|\log\hbar|$ with controlled remainders was found.

status_evidence.title: Gutzwiller's Semiclassical Trace Formula and Maslov-Type Index Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Refinement of Conley-Zehnder/Maslov indices in the semiclassical trace formula.
status_evidence.claim: Trace formula remains an active area; index-theoretic refinements continue to appear.

status_evidence.title: A Gutzwiller trace formula for large hermitian matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs discrete semiclassical Fourier integral operators approximating unitary time evolution to prove a Gutzwiller trace formula.
status_evidence.claim: Constructive Gutzwiller-type formulas are typically established for bounded (short) times.

status_evidence.title: Exact Quantum Trace Formula from Complex Periodic Orbits
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work extends periodic-orbit trace formulas via complexification of orbit periods.
status_evidence.claim: Extending periodic-orbit trace formulas beyond standard regimes is currently being pursued.
